description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecord class, an ORM-mapped entity representing immigration document records (such as passports and visas) linked to an employee within the HRM system. It includes properties for passport/visa details, dates, comments, status, and country code, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecord
classes.description: Entity class representing employee immigration records, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database mapping and includes constants for document types.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity for this immigration record.

methods.name: getRecordId
methods.description: Returns the record ID of the immigration record.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the passport or visa number.

methods.name: setNumber
methods.description: Sets the passport or visa number.

methods.name: getIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the passport or visa was issued.

methods.name: getExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the expiry date of the document.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns comments related to the record.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the document type (passport or visa).

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the country code associated with the document.
